Author: haphazard
Name: PriceScout
Description:
Market board prices from Universalis, in game: the cheapest listing on every world in your data center or region, prices on item tooltips, and a right-click "Check Prices" option.
Also includes a watchlist with price alerts, price history charts, crafting profit, a shopping list that finds the cheapest worlds, an undercut checker for your retainers and a retainer sales log.
Use /pricescout (or /psc) to open it, or /pricescout <item name> to look something up.
Punchline: Check market board prices across worlds without leaving the game.
